engineering_authorization: user-approved capped implementation/validation only; no scientific rankings
primary_objective: complete conditional sampled physical-state history entropy
rate_role: diagnostic of sustained contribution, not lexical moral ordering
claims: C: paid three-link compounding with retained expansion
R: persistence or reconstruction over a specified physical window
L: complete finite-history difference from each matched reference
J: conjunction in one setting with a joint compounding-and-later-function path readout

joint_claim_variants.J_thermal: C/R plus positive finite-history seed advantage over full same-law thermal reference
joint_claim_variants.J_unbound: C/R plus positive finite-history seed advantage over initially unbound same-law reference
joint_claim_variants.J_mechanism: C/R plus full mechanism beating both all-assistance-off and C-to-A-cut from matched seed/boundaries
joint_claim_variants.strong_seed_connected: add non-negligible depth-by64 and later-function joint path probability
joint_claim_variants.warning: these claims are distinct and may not be substituted for one another

physical_proposal.capture_reverse: one reverse per native origin with h*exp[-beta*(packet_energy-loaded_energy)]
physical_proposal.equilibrium_check: source and external damage off; full packet/bank chemistry; fixed-D sectors

roots.thermal_reference: undriven equilibrium conditioned on H7,D0 with physical count multiplicity
roots.reference_average: average conditional known-root histories; no entropy of drawing root

anchors.selection: all four fixed anchors, independent of lushness results

robustness_batch.pulse_kernel: remove one B to usable precursor if present; otherwise identity; account released energy

compounding_witness.method: conservative uniqueness-guarded initial-seed query monitor; failure never restarts primary witness
compounding_witness.required_validation: monitor projection exactly recovers physical Q; full transition table frozen before science
compounding_witness.scope: model-relative causal witness lower bound, not atomic genealogy from counts
compounding_witness.any_start_monitor: non-overlapping lower-bound detected completion rate, reset to waiting on failure/completion, no same-event restart; not a population generation rate
compounding_witness.companion_readouts: native forward/reverse link fluxes, retained expansion, query failure mass

measurement.reducible_analysis: class/projection and residual background; no irreducible shortcut
measurement.grain_scope: chemical count-state grain; spatial gas claim requires Stage C

proposed_markers.interpretation: reporting benchmarks, not reward terms or eligibility filters

funding_diagnostic.gross_capture: may include initially stored, bath-return and reverse-capture packets
funding_diagnostic.zero_source_control: external funding must remain zero even with capture/recycling

deferred_separate_freezes.source_window_queries: closure time, twice and four times lifetime, with actual post-closure dynamics
deferred_separate_freezes.spatial_same_law_replication: positions/local fuel/contact, all native agitation, naturally assembling references, memory gate
deferred_separate_freezes.matched_work_companion: stationary accepted external work only; does not match activity, total bath import or finite cumulative work
deferred_separate_freezes.whole_type_knockout: remove all B into usable precursor; separate from primary one-B pulse
deferred_separate_freezes.single_type_comparator: matched catalytic strength; network robustness advantage not assumed

persistence_prediction.tau_up: unconditional expected integral of loop-function indicator over [0,W]
persistence_prediction.P7a: larger tau_up predicted to associate with larger full-minus-ablated and seed-minus-unbound finite advantage within each fixed anchor; not a theorem
persistence_prediction.P7b: separate window freeze: asymptotic T_cross=-delta_offset/delta_rate only for positive mechanism delta_rate and validated approximation; exact finite profiles score signs
persistence_prediction.same_Q_warning: irreducible roots share rate: no rate-based T_cross for seed versus unbound
persistence_prediction.window_warning: shutdown score is maintained prefix; post-shutdown dynamics require new propagation
persistence_prediction.scope: restricted persistence/repayment hypothesis, not general field theorem

required_outputs: full C/R/L/J component maps and filed predictions
per-type and total stocks versus gross/reverse/thermal creation
arrival versus occupancy versus recovery versus structural closure
finite lushness, rate/offset and horizon-tail diagnostics
expected jumps, finite temporal term and fixed-jump diagnostics
accepted versus offered work, damage and reconstruction activity
all negative, grain-conditional and unresolved outcomes
pending_before_freeze: multinomial balance and full reversible resource validation
profiled compute budget and final numerical tolerances
marker confirmation and final prediction contract
publication: no commit, push or Drive change implied
